newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks edge lower in morning, hurt by Dow.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks edge lower in morning, hurt by Dow.

text.p: Tokyo stocks edged lower in early Monday morning trade, after opening a tad higher, momentarily shrugging off losses posted in New York on Friday, brokers said. They said however that market sentiment was rather weak and the Nikkei average was eyeing the 20,000 level.
At 0017 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was down 46.52 points or 0.23 percent at 20,120.38. Its September futures were down 20 yen at 20,150.
"The Nikkei average's sudden dive last week was pretty steep," one broker at a medium-sized brokerage said. "The downward momentum should start waning today."
